rule: 11.2.5 and G-4: every output is a QuantLib value (discountBond, discountBondOption, the curve discount) or plain arithmetic on one (zero_rate)

barrier_g.rule: continuous-monitoring rows only; the BGK rows have MC evidence, not an outside library value

swaption_g.rule: QuantLib 1.44 JamshidianSwaptionEngine on a VanillaSwap (par floater on the same curve, NullCalendar, ACT/365F), relative 3e-7 (R5 H1); CVA as G-16 bucket arithmetic on the engine EEs

g2pp_g.rule: QuantLib G2 discountBond and discountBondOption on a DiscountCurve; zero_rate and the curve discounts as arithmetic or curve values

exposure_g.rule: QuantLib 1.44 JamshidianSwaptionEngine on a VanillaSwap (par floater on the same curve, NullCalendar, ACT/365F), relative 3e-7 (R5 H1); CVA as G-16 bucket arithmetic on the engine EEs

hwcal_g.rule: not counted: the fitted sigma is this platform's least-squares optimum; QuantLib reprices the fitted prices (evidence only)

capfloor_g.rule: QuantLib Vasicek, CoxIngersollRoss, HullWhite discountBondOption per caplet, scaled by (1 + K tau) and summed

swaption_affine_g.rule: QuantLib 1.44 JamshidianSwaptionEngine on a VanillaSwap (par floater on the same curve, NullCalendar, ACT/365F), relative 3e-7 (R5 H1); CVA as G-16 bucket arithmetic on the engine EEs

bermudan_g.rule: not counted: the golden is the pinned scheme; QuantLib FD and tree values are convergence evidence (oracle/BERMUDAN_EVIDENCE_G.json)

lmmcap_g.rule: QuantLib AbcdFunction.covariance(0, T_fix, T_fix, T_fix), DiscountCurve.discount and blackFormula per caplet, summed

lmmswn_g.rule: QuantLib AbcdFunction.covariance(0, T0, T_i, T_j) per pair, DiscountCurve.discount for weights and annuity, blackFormula; exp correlation by arithmetic
